title: Bay State Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy an Interruptible Gas Supply Agreement with 143 Main Street Realty Corp., Springfield, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Bay State Gas Company d/b/a Columbia Gas
filings: The Department notes that the rate for the IS contract exceeds the Company's marginal cost for services provided. Therefore, the Department APROVES the contract. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC99-41)
